territorial_scope.description: Applies to personal information protection compliance audits carried out within the territory of the People's Republic of China.

evidence.quote: 在中华人民共和国境内开展个人信息保护合规审计，适用本办法。

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Sets rules for personal information protection compliance audits in China, effective 1 May 2025. Processors handling over 10 million people's data must audit at least every two years, and protection departments may order audits after serious risks or large leaks, following an annexed audit guideline.
summary.long: Order No. 18 of the Cyberspace Administration of China, adopted 20 May 2024, effective 1 May 2025. Governs personal information protection compliance audits within the PRC, defined as supervisory review of compliance with laws and administrative regulations. Processors may audit internally or through entrusted bodies (Art. 3); those handling over 10 million people's data must audit at least every two years (Art. 4). Protection departments may require an audit for serious risks or after a security incident exposing 1 million or more personal records or 100,000 or more sensitive records (Art. 5); the processor pays and must rectify and report within 15 working days (Arts. 8, 11). Processors over 1 million people must designate a protection officer, and major platforms an external-majority oversight body (Art. 12). Audit bodies must be qualified, may not subcontract, and may not audit the same object more than three consecutive times (Arts. 7, 14, 15). An annex guideline lists review items, including consent, notice, cross-border transfer, automated decisions, sensitive data and minors under 14. Violations are dealt with under the Personal Information Protection Law and the Network Data Security Regulations, with criminal liability where applicable (Art. 18). State organs and public-affairs bodies are excluded (Art. 19).

notes: Text is the CAC web page reproducing Order No. 18: signed 2025-02-12, effective 2025-05-01 (Art. 20). The preamble gives adoption at the 2024-05-20 meeting. definitions.term: 个人信息保护合规审计

evidence.quote: 本办法所称个人信息保护合规审计，是指对个人信息处理者的个人信息处理活动是否遵守法律、行政法规的情况进行审查和评价的监督活动。
国家网信部门和其他履行个人信息保护职责的部门（以下统称为保护部门）

obligations.summary: A personal information processor that conducts its own compliance audit must have it done by an internal body or by a commissioned professional institution, on a regular basis, covering compliance with laws and administrative regulations.
obligations.conditional_on: Processor conducts its own personal information protection compliance audit

evidence.quote: 个人信息处理者自行开展个人信息保护合规审计的，应当由个人信息处理者内部机构或者委托专业机构定期对其处理个人信息遵守法律、行政法规的情况进行合规审计。

obligations.summary: Processors handling personal information of more than 10 million persons must conduct a compliance audit at least once every two years.
obligations.conditional_on: Processor handles personal information of more than 10 million persons

evidence.quote: 处理超过1000万人个人信息的个人信息处理者，应当每两年至少开展一次个人信息保护合规审计。

obligations.summary: When a protection department requires it in one of the listed situations (serious risk, possible infringement of many persons, or a security incident affecting large numbers of persons), the processor must have a compliance audit carried out by a professional institution.
obligations.conditional_on: Protection department requires an audit in a situation listed in Art. 5(1)-(3)

evidence.quote: 可以要求个人信息处理者委托专业机构对个人信息处理活动进行合规审计

obligations.summary: The same personal information security incident or risk may not be used to repeatedly require a processor to commission a professional institution for a compliance audit.
obligations.conditional_on: Same personal information security incident or risk

evidence.quote: 对同一个人信息安全事件或者风险，不得重复要求个人信息处理者委托专业机构开展个人信息保护合规审计。

obligations.summary: A processor that audits itself or is audited by a commissioned institution at the protection department's request must refer to the Personal Information Protection Compliance Audit Guidelines annexed to the Measures.
obligations.conditional_on: Self-conducted audit, or audit by a commissioned institution at the protection department's request

evidence.quote: 个人信息处理者自行开展或者按照保护部门要求委托专业机构开展个人信息保护合规审计的，应当参照本办法附件《个人信息保护合规审计指引》。

obligations.summary: A professional institution must have the capability to conduct personal information protection compliance audits, including auditing staff, premises, facilities and funds suited to its services.
obligations.conditional_on: Professional institution conducts personal information protection compliance audits

evidence.quote: 专业机构应当具备开展个人信息保护合规审计的能力，有与服务相适应的审计人员、场所、设施和资金等。

obligations.summary: Relevant professional institutions are encouraged to obtain certification, which follows the certification regulations cited in the Article.

evidence.quote: 鼓励相关专业机构通过认证。

obligations.summary: A processor auditing at the protection department's request must give necessary support to the professional institution and bear the audit fees.
